_key.description: Variant key, genomic element key and the source name AFGR joined by underscores.

label.description: Non-method specific human readable label for the node or edge

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction

p_value.description: Nominal p-value of association between the variant and chromatin accessibility of the peak.

beta.description: Regression coefficient of the alternate allele on chromatin accessibility.

source.description: The database, dataset or organization that is a source for these data.

files_filesets.description: Reference to the File and Metadata

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the sample the assay was run in, taken from the associated files_filesets record.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the experimental sample, or the sample the prediction is valid for

name.description: Directional human readable label for the relationship, _from to _to.

inverse_name.description: Reversed directional human readable label for the relationship, _to to _from.

method.description: Name of the experimental class or prediction model that produced this result.

class.description: The class of the data this record belongs to: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship.

accessible_via.return: neg_log10_pvalue, p_value, beta, source, label, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term, name, inverse_name, method
